<!-- What does this PR change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` — tooling, config, pipelines

## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (it becomes a changelog entry)
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm e2e` passes
- [ ] New fetches are covered by MSW handlers (`src/mocks/handlers.ts`)
- [ ] Accessibility floor respected (WCAG 2.2 AA; extend `src/test/a11y.test.tsx` for new routes)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README.md / ARCHITECTURE.md) if behavior or structure changed
